thread:
sre-pager: Pager: P0 - inference-canary pods crashlooping after rollout v2026.03. Errors spike, HPA flapping, and multiple evictions observed. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/deploy-failures

alice: oncall here, acked. I'll take lead and start triage.

incident-bot: Incident INC-3181234567 created and paged to #incidents and oncall. Severity: P1.

bob: CI deployed image inference:v2026.03 at 3181234500 (canary subset). Saw 3/5 canaries restart repeatedly.

k8s-bot: `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep inference-canary`
```
inference-canary-0   0/2   CrashLoopBackOff   5 (2m ago)
inference-canary-1   1/2   Running            0
inference-canary-2   0/2   CrashLoopBackOff   7 (30s ago)
```

alice: logs show init container failing on mounting config, but app container also OOMKilled repeatedly. suspect manifest change + HPA config.

bob: found that the new rollout included an HPA change: minReplicas: 0 -> caused scale-to-zero behaviour during drain bursts and then HPA reacted with big scale ups. Also readinessProbe timeout change may have triggered evictions.

carol: toggling feature flag `inference-experimental` -> OFF to stop routing traffic to canary :white_check_mark:

bob: initiating fast rollback to v2026.02 now: `deploy-bot rollback inference-canary --to v2026.02`

deploy-bot: rollback started for inference-canary, target v2026.02. Progress: 1/5 -> 3/5 -> in progress.

alice: cordoning noisy node k8s-node-12 to reduce eviction pressure: `kubectl cordon k8s-node-12` then `kubectl drain k8s-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force`

k8s-bot: sample pod logs from inference-canary-0:
```
[2026-03-18T21:02:11Z] ERROR: Failed to load /etc/inference/config.yaml: permission denied
[2026-03-18T21:02:12Z] WARNING: Memory usage 1.9G / limit 2G -> OOMKilled
```

support-bot: Customer impact: 12 customer tickets created in last 40m, multiple customers reported intermittent 503s and elevated p95. Notifying account leads for top impacted customers.

bob: rollback completed, all canaries replaced with v2026.02. HPA manifest reverted to minReplicas: 2.

k8s-bot: post-rollback status check: no CrashLoopBackOff in last 5m, HPA target replicas steady at 3.

alice: uncordoning k8s-node-12 once pods stable: `kubectl uncordon k8s-node-12`

incident-bot: Incident INC-3181234567 severity lowered to P2. Monitoring window started for 30m.

bob: assigning postmortem to carol. Action items: (1) CI gate to validate HPA minReplicas and readinessProbe, (2) deploy checklist to include cordon impacts and eviction risk, (3) add automated test for init container mount permissions.

carol: will own postmortem and follow-ups, ETA preliminary draft by EOD.

alice: marking this thread as resolved for now. Leaving follow-ups in INC-3181234567 and the deploy checklist PR. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
